name: Auto-layout Fragment
description: Runs bpmn-auto-layout over a fragment (or the current session graph, if no fragment is given), producing <bpmndi:> positioning for it.

properties.label: Fragment
properties.description: FEEL expression yielding the BPMN fragment to lay out. Leave the default to lay out the session's current graph instead.

properties.label: Laid out fragment
properties.description: Process variable the laid-out fragment is published to.
